preprocessing_definition.behavioral_representation: Prevention, hygiene and contact-avoidance scores with coverage replace seven individual behavioral questions. Health-context score and its source variables remain separate.
preprocessing_definition.age_encoding: One ordered age column: 18-34=0, 35-44=.25, 45-54=.5, 55-64=.75, 65+=1. Ranks are not exact ages; new missing ages require explicit review.
preprocessing_definition.income_encoding: Ordered income (0, 0.5, 1) plus unknown flag only; no income-band indicators.
preprocessing_definition.nominal_encoding: Full indicators for every observed nominal category; no reference group omitted. Original numeric binary questions and insurance keep compact value/unknown columns.

joint_doctor_recommendations.doctor_recc_both: 1 only when both original answers are 1; otherwise 0
joint_doctor_recommendations.doctor_recc_neither: 1 only when both original answers are 0; otherwise 0
joint_doctor_recommendations.doctor_recc_h1n1_only: 1 only when H1N1 recommendation=1 and seasonal recommendation=0; otherwise 0
joint_doctor_recommendations.doctor_recc_seasonal_only: 1 only when H1N1 recommendation=0 and seasonal recommendation=1; otherwise 0
joint_doctor_recommendations.missing_policy: Any missing original answer makes all four pattern indicators 0; preserve original recommendation values and missing flags.

preprocessing_definition.opinion_encoding: Each question separately: 1=0,2=1/3,4=2/3,5=1; code3 has dont_know=1, NaN has unknown=1; unavailable scores stored as 0 with flags. No cross-vaccine averaging.
preprocessing_definition.aggregate_missing_policy: Behavior and health-context means use known binary answers only and require minimum coverage; unavailable scores stored as 0 with coverage retained. Vaccine-specific opinions use separate ordered scores, dont-know flags and missing flags; no combined opinion summaries.

baseline_preprocessing_state.unseen_policy: Known rare and unseen nonmissing job categories map to __Other__ only when learned in training; other unseen categories require review. Missing is never silently mapped to a real answer.

preprocessing_definition.fit_source: All new mappings fixed a priori; baseline vocabulary/grouping learned on training only.
preprocessing_definition.cross_validation: Refit baseline vocabulary and rare grouping on each fold training partition.

cv_preprocessing: SurveyFeatures fitted separately within each fold. No pre-encoded CV input.
limits: Validation is development data after feature exploration, not a fresh final test.
Importance is model-dependent association, not causation.
Correlated predictors share importance; scores/flags should be interpreted together.
CV covers filtered training respondents; validation also includes high-unknown respondents.
